newsitem.title: EGYPT: Libya hopes Arabs will hold summit meeting soon.
newsitem.headline: Libya hopes Arabs will hold summit meeting soon.

text.p: Libya said on Tuesday it hoped Arab leaders would hold a summit meeting soon to coordinate their policies in the region.
Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak met with senior Libyan envoy Colonel Mustafa Kharrubi and Libyan official Hassouna al-Shawamsy on Tuesday.
Shawamsy told reporters after the meeting that they had discussed the need to hold a summit meeting.
"Among the suggestions discussed was the necessity of holding a summit meeting and we hope an Arab summit will be held soon," Shawamsy said.
Arab officials have bandied about the idea of a summit since Israel started work on a controversial Jewish housing project in disputed Arab East Jerusalem.

Arab leaders say the project has thrown the whole Middle East peace process into crisis and Mubarak last week held talks with Lebanese and Syrian officials as well as Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
Syria is sympathetic to the idea but Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa told reporters after the meeting they were not yet considering a summit.
